tables.name: users
tables.description: User accounts for authentication and identification.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, auto-generated UUID.

columns.name: email
columns.description: User email, used for login and must be unique.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.description: Bcrypt hash of the user's password.

columns.name: role
columns.description: Role of the user: admin, member, or viewer.

columns.name: email_verified
columns.description: Indicates if the email has been verified.

columns.name: last_login
columns.description: Timestamp of the user's last login.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the user was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the user was last updated.

tables.name: workspaces
tables.description: Workspaces that contain boards. Each workspace has an owner.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, auto-generated UUID.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the workspace.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Optional description of the workspace.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the user who owns the workspace.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the workspace was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

tables.name: workspace_members
tables.description: Many-to-many relationship between users and workspaces, indicating membership with a role.

columns.name: workspace_id
columns.description: Foreign key to workspace.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key to user.

columns.name: role
columns.description: Role of the user in the workspace: admin or member.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when membership was created.

tables.name: boards
tables.description: Boards that belong to a workspace. They contain lists.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, auto-generated UUID.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Title of the board.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Optional description of the board.

columns.name: visibility
columns.description: Visibility level: public, private, or workspace.

columns.name: workspace_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the workspace containing this board.

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: Foreign key to the user who created the board.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the board was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the board was last updated.

tables.name: lists
tables.description: Lists within a board, representing columns like To Do, In Progress, Done.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, auto-generated UUID.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Title of the list.

columns.name: position
columns.description: Order of the list within the board, used for sorting.

columns.name: board_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the board containing this list.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the list was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the list was last updated.

tables.name: cards
tables.description: Cards within a list, representing tasks or items.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, auto-generated UUID.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Title of the card.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Optional detailed description of the card.

columns.name: position
columns.description: Order of the card within the list, used for sorting.

columns.name: due_date
columns.description: Optional due date for the card.

columns.name: list_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the list containing this card.

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: Foreign key to the user who created the card.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the card was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the card was last updated.

tables.name: card_assignments
tables.description: Many-to-many relationship between cards and users, representing assigned members.

columns.name: card_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the card.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the user assigned to the card.

columns.name: assigned_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the user was assigned to the card.

tables.name: comments
tables.description: Comments left on cards by users.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, auto-generated UUID.

columns.name: content
columns.description: The text content of the comment.

columns.name: card_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the card the comment belongs to.

columns.name: author_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the user who wrote the comment. Nullable to preserve comment if user is deleted.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the comment was last updated.
